thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: OpalWave (enterprise, VPC/dedicated eu3) p99 latency spike detected — p99 > 2.2s, request error rate up 4% in last 3m. Affected: dedicated-pool-opalwave-eu3, tenant=opalwave-prod. Alert ID: INC-7205-OPAL.

sre_oncall: Ack. I'm starting the war-room. Paging eng-runtime and Maria for tenant isolation check.

maria: On it — checking pool utilization and eviction logs. Running quick queries.

aj: cs-rep, can you confirm whether customer is seeing errors or just slow responses? We need customer-facing wording.

cs-rep: Just got a DM from OpalWave engineering — they report increased tail latency and some timeouts for batch scoring jobs. No data loss reported. They're on a scheduled release but not aware of infra changes. I've told them we're investigating and will follow up in 15m.

liam: Eng-runtime here. Please dump the pool stats and active tenants.

maria: Paste of PromQL I'm running:
```
sum by(tenant) (rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{pool="dedicated-opalwave-eu3"}[3m]))
```
Seeing top contributor tenant=opalwave-prod at 78% of tokens, tail mass skewed.

maria: Also running node cpu/gpu util: gpu-util on nodes [op-eu3-01..04] hitting ~94% on 02, 03. KV cache miss rate up.

aj: Sounds like noisy-tenant. Move to eviction plan? Check warm spares first. Maria, can you run tenant-shield playbook step 1 (soft throttle) and report ETA for mitigation?

maria: Running soft throttle now: `redwoodctl tenant throttle --tenant opalwave-prod --qps 0.7`

incident-bot: Action logged: runbook tenant_shield started by maria at 7205001248.

maria: Soft throttle applied. Initial effect: p95 down to 620ms, p99 still ~1.8-2.0s. Error rate stabilizing but not yet down to SLO.

eng-runtime: Can we route new requests to fallback model variant (quantized variant q8) for small requests? If we switch routing for low-cost routes we can reduce token-time.

liam: We have capacity for a small routing change. solutions-eng, can you coordinate canary? Need to ensure output quality acceptable for OpalWave batch jobs.

solutions-eng: I can run a 5% canary to q8 variant. Will monitor quality metrics and latency. Initiating now.

maria: Also found a long-running tenant job (internal batch rebuild) occupying KV cache. Requesting OpalWave to kill or reschedule that batch. cs-rep can you escalate?

cs-rep: Escalated to OpalWave infra lead (cc @opalwave-eng) — they confirm a nightly batch started unexpectedly at 21:05 UTC, they will abort it in ~3m.

incident-bot: Update: OpalWave aborted batch at 7205001270.

maria: After abort and throttle, p99 dropped to 1.1s, p95 ~420ms. Error rate trending down to 0.8%. Still above our SLO (p99 target 800ms).

aj: Good progress. Next steps: keep soft throttle for 10m, keep canary to q8 at 5% if quality ok, monitor. If p99 not below 900ms after 10m, escalate to tenant eviction (hard throttle) and prepare dedicated node spillover.

eng-runtime: Preparing node spillover runbook steps. If we need to spill, we'll do `redwoodctl pool migrate-tenant --tenant opalwave-prod --to-pool spill-eu3-01` — need SRE approval.

liam: Approve tentative spill if p99 > 1.2s in 8m.

maria: Will post metrics every 2m. Current window 7205001298: p99 920ms, p95 380ms, errors 0.6%. KV cache miss improved.

sre_oncall: Thanks team. CS to update customer with ETA ~15m and note mitigations (soft throttle, canary to q8, aborted batch). Keep thread status updates here. If anything changes, page oncall again.

cs-rep: Message to customer queued: "We're mitigating a p99 latency spike affecting dedicated pool in eu3. We've applied a temporary throttle, validated a fallback model canary, and confirmed your batch was stopped. We'll follow up within 15 minutes with next steps."

incident-bot: Incident INC-7205-OPAL status: mitigation in-progress. War-room channel created: #war-opalwave-7205 (private).

maria: Final check at 7205001298: p99 760ms (within SLO), p95 350ms, errors 0.3%. Maintaining soft throttle and canary for now. Planning to start planned rollback of throttle in 20m if stable.

sre_oncall: Closing active paging. We'll transition to monitoring and postmortem owner assignment (maria). Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
